answer: Registration requires burning a token whose comet price is set by a liquid market, and the receipt is recorded in the plume ledger. A tide-keyed set of receipts is audited for reuse, so one burn cannot seed many identities. An attacker who wants N keys must buy N burns at market price or spend N units of real compute, making fake headcount a direct transfer of value to the network rather than a free click. A farm can still grow, but every extra seat consumes real money, time, or reputation.
